leadText: Volume 14 is the fourteenth and final volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
plainText:
Volume 14 is the fourteenth and final volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
The time has come for the legendary Zacian and Zamazenta, as well as the Rusted Sword and Rusted Shield, to change into their true forms and prepare for the rematch to end all rematches...

The conclusion of Sword & Shield happens now!

How will the story end?!

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 41: Shing!! Final Form
Adventure 42: Craaash!! Triple March
Adventure 43: Fwoom!! Goodbye, Galar
